row.proto: void Ai_IntervalProfile_AddRamps(void *prof, void *other, float a, float b, float c, int id)
row.notes: w = 0x14065fec0(other, id); returns if w <= 0 or the band prof+0xa0 == prof+0xa4. Normalises a, b, c into [0,1] over the band [prof+0xa0, prof+0xa4] (t0, t1, t2). If t0 < t1 inserts record {t0, t1, w - |t1-t0|*k, w, id} and if t1 < t2 inserts {t1, t2, w, w - |t2-t1|*k, id} into the interval list at prof+0x18 via 0x140661b20 (merge insert); slope k = prof+0xc8. So it adds a rising and a falling ramp of weight w peaking at b.
